QCitizens, let's enjoy summer responsibly by practicing road safety! 🚦☀️

Habang dumarami ang gala, road trips, at bonding ngayong bakasyon, mahalaga pa ring maging alerto at disiplinado sa daan. 🚶‍♂️🛵🚗

Kaya naman, tara na at makiisa sa Road Safety Awareness Seminar for Youth na inihanda ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) ngayong May 13, 2026!

Sama-sama tayong matuto tungkol sa traffic rules, road signs, at wastong asal sa kalsada para makaiwas sa aksidente at mas mapanatiling ligtas ang ating pagbiyahe. 🚸🛑📚

Tandaan: Tumatawid ka man o nagmamaneho, may mga taong naghihintay sa’yong ligtas na makauwi. Lagi nating piliin ang kaligtasan sa tuwing nasa lansangan. ❤️

Para sa karagdagang impormasyon, maaaring makipag-ugnayan sa Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD):

NEWS UPDATE | Another Fire Blazed in Taguig

A third alarm fire broke out in Barangay Bagumbayan in Taguig City, Wednesday night. This is the second consecutive fire that has occurred in the said city.

According to the BFP, 56 fire trucks responded including the Barangay Pinagsama Fire Brigade with Manila Standard Reporter Vince Lopez as a fire volunteer, as well as firefighters from neighboring cities and barangays in Taguig.

Taguig City Mayor Lani Cayetano also arrived at the said area and assured the affected families that the said city will provide the necessary assistance. No injuries or deaths were reported in the said incident. | via Vince Lopez

For more details please visit https://t.co/rmQCnNSgGa

    ℕ𝕆𝕀𝕊𝔼 📣 𝔹𝔸ℝℝ𝔸𝔾𝔼
       "𝕍𝕆𝕋𝔼 𝕆ℝ 𝕍𝔼𝕋𝕆?"
    𝕋𝕙𝕖 𝔽𝕣𝕖𝕢𝕦𝕖𝕟𝕔𝕪 𝕊𝕙𝕚𝕗𝕥 
          𝟙𝟡𝟠𝟔 𝕧𝕤. 𝟚𝟘𝟚𝟞
~​Before we dive into the receipts, we need to understand the "𝑺𝒕𝒂𝒕𝒊𝒄" we are hearing. 
~The days leading up to EDSA, the "𝑵𝒐𝒊𝒔𝒆 𝑩𝒂𝒓𝒓𝒂𝒈𝒆" was a physical symphony of resistance—pots, pans, and sirens used to prove that the people were awake and watching. 
~It was an organic signal of unity against a regime that tried to silence the nation.
~​Fast forward to May 2026, and the "𝑵𝒐𝒊𝒔𝒆 𝑩𝒂𝒓𝒓𝒂𝒈𝒆" has been weaponized. 
~It’s about 
"𝑫𝒊𝒈𝒊𝒕𝒂𝒍 𝑭𝒍𝒐𝒐𝒅𝒊𝒏𝒈" designed to put them back to sleep. 
~Instead of pots and pans, we have "𝑻𝒓𝒐𝒍𝒍 𝑭𝒂𝒓𝒎𝒔," "𝑺𝒄𝒓𝒊𝒑𝒕𝒆𝒅 𝑫𝒆𝒇𝒍𝒆𝒄𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏𝒔," and "𝑬𝒙𝒕𝒐𝒓𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏-𝒃𝒂𝒔𝒆𝒅 𝑻𝒆𝒂𝒔𝒆𝒓𝒔." 

The goal of the 1986 noise was Transparency; the goal of the 2026 noise is Distortion to protect the powerful from the "𝑹𝒆𝒄𝒆𝒊𝒑𝒕𝒔" of the Impeachment.

​🔹️ 𝕄𝕒𝕣𝕔𝕠𝕝𝕖𝕥𝕒 "𝕄𝕦𝕥𝕖" 
  𝔹𝕦𝕥𝕥𝕠𝕟
​➡️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐍𝐨𝐢𝐬𝐞:
𝑺𝒆𝒏. 𝑹𝒐𝒅𝒂𝒏𝒕𝒆 𝑴𝒂𝒓𝒄𝒐𝒍𝒆𝒕𝒂
has been flooding the airwaves with "𝑻𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒔𝒐𝒏" claims against Justice Carpio and attempting to block the Senate Blue Ribbon flood control probe.
​➡️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐩𝐭:
On May 6, 2026, 
𝑺𝒆𝒏𝒂𝒕𝒆 𝑷𝒓𝒆𝒔𝒊𝒅𝒆𝒏𝒕 𝑷𝒓𝒐 𝑻𝒆𝒎𝒑𝒐𝒓𝒆 𝑷𝒂𝒏𝒇𝒊𝒍𝒐 𝑳𝒂𝒄𝒔𝒐𝒏 dropped the "𝑩𝒐𝒎𝒃𝒂." 
~He revealed a handwritten note from the late 𝑫𝑷𝑾𝑯 𝑼𝒔𝒆𝒄. 𝑪𝒂𝒕𝒉𝒚 𝑪𝒂𝒃𝒓𝒂𝒍 showing that 𝑺𝒆𝒏. 𝑴𝒂𝒓𝒄𝒐𝒍𝒆𝒕𝒂 allegedly received PHP500 million in "𝒂𝒍𝒍𝒐𝒄𝒂𝒃𝒍𝒆𝒔" for projects. 
~𝑺𝒆𝒏.𝑳𝒂𝒄𝒔𝒐𝒏 plans to submit this to the Ombudsman, exposing that 𝑺𝒆𝒏.𝑴𝒂𝒓𝒄𝒐𝒍𝒆𝒕𝒂’𝒔 "𝑵𝒐𝒊𝒔𝒆" is a shield for his own 500-million-peso trail.

​🔹️ "𝕃𝕖𝕧𝕚𝕤𝕥𝕖" 𝕃𝕠𝕨-𝕎𝕒𝕥𝕥𝕒𝕘𝕖 𝔽𝕒𝕕𝕖𝕣
​➡️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐍𝐨𝐢𝐬𝐞:
𝑹𝒆𝒑 𝑳𝒆𝒂𝒏𝒅𝒓𝒐 𝑳𝒆𝒗𝒊𝒔𝒕𝒆 used his plenary speech to hurl unverified PHP1 billion bribery allegations against 𝑬𝑺 𝑹𝒂𝒍𝒑𝒉 𝑹𝒆𝒄𝒕𝒐, painting himself as a victim of political harassment.
​➡️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐑𝐞𝐚𝐥𝐢𝐭𝐲 𝐂𝐡𝐞𝐜𝐤:
The "𝑵𝒐𝒊𝒔𝒆" is a distraction from the PHP24 billion penalty slapped on his firm by the DOE for failing to deliver energy. 
~On May 6, 2026, the DOE officially filed cases against his solar companies for 
"𝒘𝒊𝒍𝒍𝒇𝒖𝒍𝒍𝒚 𝒏𝒆𝒈𝒍𝒆𝒄𝒕𝒊𝒏𝒈" to provide electricity. 
~Zero Kilowatts, 
Maximum 𝑵𝒐𝒊𝒔𝒆.

​🔹️𝔹𝕒𝕡𝕥𝕚𝕤𝕥 𝔹𝕒𝕥𝕥𝕝𝕖𝕘𝕣𝕠𝕦𝕟𝕕
​➡️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐍𝐨𝐢𝐬𝐞:
A specific group of Baptist pastors has emerged to protest the VP’s impeachment, claiming 
"𝒓𝒆𝒍𝒊𝒈𝒊𝒐𝒖𝒔 𝒑𝒆𝒓𝒔𝒆𝒄𝒖𝒕𝒊𝒐𝒏.
​➡️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐒𝐢𝐠𝐧𝐚𝐥:
𝑹𝒆𝒑 𝑩𝒆𝒏𝒏𝒚 𝑨𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒕𝒆—
a Baptist pastor himself—has called out this "𝑪𝒐𝒏𝒄𝒆𝒓𝒕𝒆𝒅 𝑵𝒐𝒊𝒔𝒆." 
~He maintains that accountability for public funds is a moral mandate, signaling a deep divide between those seeking truth and those acting as political "𝒔𝒉𝒊𝒆𝒍𝒅𝒔."

​🔹️ "𝔼𝕩𝕥𝕠𝕣𝕥𝕚𝕠𝕟" 𝕊𝕥𝕒𝕥𝕚𝕜: 
  𝕄𝕒𝕓𝕒𝕟𝕥𝕒 & ℙ𝕦𝕝𝕠𝕟𝕘
​➡️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐍𝐨𝐢𝐬𝐞:
𝑭𝒓𝒂𝒏𝒄𝒐 𝑴𝒂𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒕𝒂 𝒂𝒏𝒅 
𝑹𝒆𝒑. "𝑷𝒖𝒍𝒐𝒏𝒈" 𝑫𝒖𝒕𝒆𝒓𝒕𝒆 have been operating a 
"𝑵𝒆𝒘𝒔 𝑩𝒂𝒓𝒓𝒂𝒈𝒆"to discredit the impeachment process.
​➡️ 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐌𝐚𝐛𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐚 𝐑𝐞𝐜𝐞𝐢𝐩𝐭:
On May 5, 2026, the NBI arrested 𝑭𝒓𝒂𝒏𝒄𝒐 𝑴𝒂𝒃𝒂𝒏𝒕𝒂 in an entrapment operation for allegedly trying to extort PHP350 million from 
𝑹𝒆𝒑. 𝑹𝒐𝒎𝒖𝒂𝒍𝒅𝒆𝒛.
~He threatened to release a fake "𝑬𝒙𝒑𝒐𝒔é 𝑽𝒊𝒅𝒆𝒐" if not paid.
​➡️ "𝐂𝐨𝐞𝐫𝐜𝐢𝐨𝐧" 𝐓𝐫𝐚𝐜𝐤:
On April 30, 2026, 
𝑹𝒆𝒑. 𝑷𝒖𝒍𝒐𝒏𝒈 𝑫𝒖𝒕𝒆𝒓𝒕𝒆 claimed that a certain "𝑪𝒉𝒂𝒓𝒊𝒔𝒔𝒆" was calling lawmakers' chiefs of staff, threatening to cut their district funds *GAA if they didn't vote for impeachment.
